sources.title: Brian Eno / Andrew Ford, ABC Music Show
sources.scope_and_limit: Consistent sonic setting, optional attention, texture and small ongoing variation; artistic intent, not a measured efficacy claim.

sources.title: Robert Rich / questions from Tomasz Kowalczyk
sources.scope_and_limit: Gradual flow, contextual listening, environmental place and multidimensional depth; avoid importing healing/physiology claims.

sources.title: Steve Roach / Long Thoughts
sources.scope_and_limit: Extended listening during development and changing sound relationships; promotional wellbeing claims are not independent research.

sources.title: KMRU: Spaces / Ableton
sources.scope_and_limit: Texture-based work without grid, quiet field recordings, processed/original layers; not a universal mixing rule.

sources.title: Patricia Wolf: Natural Synthesis / Ableton
sources.scope_and_limit: Scene-specific source selection and iterative editing/mixing; film-score narrative methods are not all adopted for long-form ambience.

sources.title: Kiss & Linnell, Psychological Research 85 (2021), 2313–2325
sources.scope_and_limit: Forty students, preferred music vs silence in low-demand vigilance task; attentional-state findings do not establish all-day comfort or our prompt recipe.
